Unit 10's number is right in the body - it is the CONTENTS that had 'KISHINA 1O' with a letter O, and that list is removed.

_note_lessons: A lesson-plan Teacher's Guide (LUFUNJISHO / KIBESE / MUTWE / BYAKUUBA MUFUNJISHI). lessonLabels nests a lettered sub-item under the numbered step above it, so a. and b. stop starting at the same margin as 1. and 2.
